newsitem.title: CANADA: Gandalf hires adviser, plans financing.
newsitem.headline: Gandalf hires adviser, plans financing.

text.p: Gandalf Technologies Inc said on Wednesday that it has hired an investment banking firm to help it pursue its goals.
The goals include raising additional financing, Gandalf said in a release.
The company blamed its poor third quarter earnings can be partly blamed on difficulties implementing a new sales distribution model.
"Gandalf has been and continues to be a company in transition," company president Richard Busto said in a statement.
He said the company has been working this year to change its sales distribution model to one driven by indirect channel sales from a primarily direct model.
Difficulties in implementing the system cut into product revenues this year but the company has taken steps to address the problems, he said.
Gandalf reported a third quarter loss of US$9.9 million or US$0.23 a share compared to a break-even third quarter of 1995.
